schedule.cutoff_guard: Wait only until the real same-day Asia/Taipei 08:30 cutoff; do not read decision sources early.

settings.recommended_execution_time_limit_status: not adopted: no measured post-cutoff producer duration is available; obtain a controlled run duration before considering an override
settings.execution_time_limit_override: Optional explicit ISO-8601 duration parameter; omitted by default
settings.retry_policy: Preserve the existing Scheduler retry setting; the current registration does not request a new retry policy.
settings.principal: preserve existing InteractiveToken principal and LeastPrivilege run level

registration.method: Dedicated Python pywin32 Task Scheduler COM update of the existing task definition.
registration.aggregate_policy: Aggregate registration delegates Paper to this dedicated updater and does not create a Pacific-local trigger for it.
registration.missing_task_policy: Fail closed; do not create a replacement task or choose a new principal.
registration.before_backup: Create-only XML backup under output/qa/scheduled_registration_backups before mutation.
registration.task_state_owner: deployment owner; this worker did not apply or read back the trigger update

rollback.method: Re-register the saved before XML for the same root task path while preserving its existing principal and task ACL.
